{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABexFXCA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhISGlU", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 134, "title": "Expose every Saturn digital pad button through keyboard and verify gamepad input", "body": "## Problem

The Play page currently exposes only a **partial Player 1 keyboard mapping** even though Saturn's standard digital controller has all four D-pad directions, **A/B/C, X/Y/Z, L/R and Start**.

On current `main` (`3490c570722c6946bf3b29cff3521fe52c3181bd`), `web/app.js` uses:

```js
const keys = { ArrowUp: 1, ArrowDown: 2, ArrowLeft: 4, ArrowRight: 8, z: 64, Enter: 128 };
```

Thus P1 keyboard controls can send only **A** and **Start** among the face/shoulder/start buttons. `web/index.html` only documents `Arrows: directions · Z: A · Enter: Start`.

**Important existing capability:** `pollGamepads()` already has a Standard Gamepad mapping for all Saturn digital buttons (A/B/C/X/Y/Z/L/R/Start plus D-pad), and `src/smpc/controller.rs::digital` plus `src/wasm.rs::set_buttons` already support the underlying button bitfield. This issue should *complete keyboard access and verify gamepad mappings*, not redundantly reimplement the native SMPC controller or misstate that all gamepad buttons are missing.

## Expected outcome

In the normal Play UI, a user can operate **every button on a standard Sega Saturn digital pad** with the keyboard; connected Standard Gamepads also reliably send every button to the correct emulated pad, with simultaneous presses, release and focus behavior preserved.

Provide an easy-to-learn default **Player 1** mapping while retaining existing bindings:

| Keyboard key (physical `KeyboardEvent.code`) | Saturn Player 1 |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown / ArrowLeft / ArrowRight | D-pad directions |
| Z / X / C (KeyZ, KeyX, KeyC) | A / B / C |
| A / S / D (KeyA, KeyS, KeyD) | X / Y / Z |
| Q / W (KeyQ, KeyW) | L / R |
| Enter | Start |

The proposal above is a compact, conflict-free default for the current Player 2 keyboard controls; the implementer may improve it if genuinely necessary, but must retain **Z→A**, **Enter→Start**, Arrow keys, and clearly document every binding. Do not add unnecessary configurable-remapping settings, a virtual touchscreen controller or a large UI redesign for this issue.

For Player 2, retain the existing I/K/J/L directions, U/O/P for A/B/C and Right Shift for Start; **avoid key collisions**. The core already supports both pads; if an equally clean non-colliding way to provide full keyboard controls for Player 2 is not in scope, explicitly document its current partial mapping rather than quietly changing it. Standard Gamepads for either port should expose the complete digital pad.

## Relevant implementation

- `web/app.js`: `keys`, `port2Keys`, window `keydown`/`keyup` handling, `buttons`, `gamepadMasks`, `pollGamepads`, `releaseButtons`, `pause` and visibility/focus handling.
- `web/index.html`: visible `#input-hint` and Advanced input help.
- `src/wasm.rs`: `set_buttons` / `set_port2_buttons` (16-bit Saturn masks).
- `src/smpc/controller.rs`: digital pad's active-low packet and 3-wire multiplexing; ensure new frontend keys are reported as authentic guest-visible pad input, not host-written guest RAM.
- `scripts/play-ui.mjs`, `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs` and relevant input/browser/SMPC tests.

Existing Standard Gamepad mask table in `web/app.js` includes:
```js
[[0,64],[1,16],[2,32],[3,1024],[4,512],[5,256],
 [6,4096],[7,2048],[9,128],[12,1],[13,2],[14,4],[15,8]]
```
Keep the physical Saturn mask assignments consistent: Up=1, Down=2, Left=4, Right=8, B=16, C=32, A=64, Start=128, Z=256, Y=512, X=1024, L=2048, R=4096. The analog/3D-pad code currently maps physical gamepad triggers separately; preserve its behavior and hysteresis.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] **Full Player 1 keyboard coverage:** all A/B/C/X/Y/Z/L/R/Start and four directions have documented, usable, distinct mappings; all produce the correct existing Saturn bit masks and guest-visible digital reports. Preserve Arrow, Z→A and Enter→Start.
- [ ] **Reliable key handling:** use physical `event.code` for alphabetic bindings so Shift/caps/layout changes do not silently break a button (or justify an equivalent robust strategy). Correctly handle simultaneous inputs, auto-repeat, keyup and modifier interactions, without stealing unrelated input when the display lacks focus.
- [ ] **Existing gamepad functionality preserved and verified:** independently test the Standard Gamepad buttons for each Saturn button including X/Y/Z and L/R, direction and Start, on both ports; verify concurrent keyboard + gamepad bitwise union and release. Preserve analog/3D axes and trigger handling.
- [ ] **No stuck buttons:** focus loss, pause, page hiding, view/settings changes, restart/mode switching and controller disconnect/reconnect release inputs correctly. Ensure the keyboard cannot inadvertently control Player 2 and that the existing P2 key bindings do not collide with new P1 ones.
- [ ] **Clear compact UI help:** update `#input-hint`, relevant Advanced help, and README if necessary so all controls can be discovered without an external mapping guide. Keep the current simple responsive disc-player design, no demo-game promotion and no added permanent controller overlay.
- [ ] **Automated guest-backed tests:** add/update production Chromium tests that synthesize keydown/keyup and Standard Gamepad button states, assert mapped mask/state transitions, and verify the corresponding input through emulated SMPC status/INTBACK or original guest code. Cover each button, simultaneous presses, both ports, blur/visibility release and keyboard/gamepad union; test against normal BIOS and HLE-compatible original fixtures as appropriate. Do not merely assert that the UI displays the key names.
- [ ] **Regression/validation:** keep existing input, gamepad, pad-2, SMPC/INTBACK, Play/Debug, audio, BIOS-only, ISO/CUE/BIN/CHD, pause/restart and security/privacy checks working. Run appropriate formatting, build/tests/Clippy, fixture checks, production Wasm build, CI runner and complete browser suite per `docs/development-flow.md` and `docs/ci-performance.md`, with successful exact-head PR CI before merge. Document testing and any remaining partial Player 2 keyboard limits.

## Optional validation

Manual testing with physical Sega-style USB controllers that expose the browser's Standard Gamepad layout. Such hardware and human confirmation are optional and not required for the automated completion criteria.

## Required post-merge verification

None. Native and production browser tests on original licensed fixtures are sufficient before merge.
